integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium shot frames a late-night beef-noodle counter from the street side, a steel stockpot steaming under a bare bulb and a row of red plastic stools along the tiled front. Above the serving hatch a neon sign reading "老张牛肉面" glows in red tube script, mounted flush to the tiled lintel and centred over the hatch. A small radio on the shelf behind the counter plays an instrumental Cantonese pop tune with no vocals, a bright synth-backed ballad at a steady mid-tempo, thin and tinny through its single speaker. The camera zooms out with small amplitude at slow speed, opening the frame from the sign to the whole counter. A male customer in a grey raincoat, on-screen, thirties, with a low, even tenor and a quick delivery (S1), steps up to the hatch, holds up two fingers toward the cook, and says: <d>[Chinese] 两碗牛肉面，一碗不要辣。</d> He closes his mouth and lowers his hand to the counter edge. The cook in a white apron behind the stockpot nods once, lifts a ladle, and produces no vocal sound. No one else appears at the counter or on the street behind.

overall_soundscape: A stockpot simmers steadily under the hum of a neon transformer. A ladle knocks against steel, a coat sleeve brushes the counter edge, and traffic passes wet and distant on the street behind.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, deadpan comedy, a medium-wide shot frames a radio-drama studio with acoustic panels on the walls, three actors standing at a row of microphones on boom stands, the last of them a young man in headphones; with the foley artist they are the only four people in the room, and a foley table stacked with props at the left of frame. Above the studio door an illuminated sign reading "ON AIR" glows in red block capitals on a white panel, mounted high on the wall at the top left of frame. A foley artist in a grey cardigan, bored and expressionless, walks from the door to her table carrying a pair of leather shoes, on-screen, and produces no vocal sound. The camera follows her as a tracking shot with small amplitude at slow speed until she sets the shoes on a square of gravel. Until the older actor speaks, the three actors stand frozen at their microphones with their mouths closed, eyes fixed on their scripts, and make no sound. An older actor in a waistcoat at the first microphone, on-screen, sixties, with a deep, quavering, wildly melodramatic bass and a slow, overwrought delivery (S1), presses the back of one hand to his brow, eyes bulging, and booms from his script toward the actress beside him: <d>[English] Someone is on the stairs.</d> His lips close and he freezes mid-pose as he lowers the page. The actress at the second microphone in a green scarf, on-screen, forties, with a breathy, trembling alto and a gasping, over-the-top delivery (S2), clutches her scarf to her throat, gasps theatrically, and answers him with her eyes wide: <d>[English] Then put out the lamp.</d> Her mouth closes and the foley artist, still expressionless, walks the shoes across the gravel in slow steps. [Shot 2] The camera cuts to a close shot of the third actor at the last microphone, a young man in headphones, on-screen, twenties, with a thin, quivering tenor and a terrified, squeaky delivery (S3), a burned-in subtitle in white sans-serif lettering sitting in the lower third of frame reading "I can hear him breathing." The camera holds a static shot. He grips the script with both hands, his eyes bulging and his lower lip trembling, looks toward the actress at the second microphone, and whispers: <d>[English] I can hear him breathing.</d><|caption_start|>I can hear him breathing.<|caption_end|> His lips close and he holds still as the foley steps stop on the gravel.

overall_soundscape: A close, padded studio room tone carries under the soft hum of a monitor speaker. Leather shoes press slowly into a tray of gravel, script pages turn, a boom stand creaks.

non_diegetic_music: A low bowed double bass at a slow tempo holds a single sustained note, joined by a sparse pizzicato figure that enters at the cut and stops on the final frame.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a high-stakes 1950s black-and-white courtroom drama plays out across the fourteen-second take, stark sunlight cutting through tall Venetian blinds onto dark mahogany paneling and a carved oak seal reading "JUSTICE UNDER LAW" behind the elevated bench. A stern trial judge in black robes sits motionless at the elevated bench with folded hands and produces no vocal sound. A relentless prosecuting attorney in a dark three-piece wool suit, on-screen, fifties, with a deep, resonant baritone and a precise, cutting delivery (S1), strides along the jury rail brandishing a gold pocket watch. Turning toward the witness stand, the prosecutor (S1) demands: <d>[English] Did you or did you not sign the transfer deed at midnight?</d> His lips clamp tightly shut and his jaw remains motionless as he pivots on his heel. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the witness box, where a man in his thirties grips the rail. [Shot 2] The shot cuts to a close medium shot of the beleaguered defendant on the witness stand, on-screen, thirties, with a hoarse, trembling tenor and a defiant cadence (S2), gripping the polished brass railing until his knuckles pale. Leaning forward over the rail toward the prosecutor, the defendant (S2) retorts: <d>[English] That signature was forged before I even reached the docks.</d> His mouth seals firmly into a grimace and his breathing catches. The camera holds a static shot on his sweat-beaded brow. [Shot 3] The camera cuts to a high-angle shot looking down over the judicial bench across the well of the courtroom as the prosecutor sets the pocket watch down onto the defense table with a sharp tap. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed, framing the murmur among spectator benches behind the railing.

overall_soundscape: Leather shoe soles squeak crisply against polished hardwood under cavernous high-ceiling room reverberation. The snap of a gold pocket watch lid closing resonates sharply, followed by an intake of breath from the gallery and the muffled shifting of wooden spectator benches.

non_diegetic_music: A brooding orchestral string motif at a slow tempo, driven by a low sustained cello pedal note and quiet tremolo violins that rise in pitch until cutting off on the final strike.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a gritty foot pursuit through an empty underground subway station across the fourteen-second take, with only two people in the whole station: a fleeing suspect and the agent chasing him. Flickering fluorescent tubes cast harsh shadows across white glazed tile walls. The suspect, a lean man in a grey hooded windbreaker who produces no vocal sound, vaults a metal turnstile beneath an illuminated overhead sign reading "DOWNTOWN PLATFORM" and runs toward a concrete stairwell leading down. The agent, a man in his thirties in a scuffed black leather jacket, on-screen, with a gruff, breathless baritone and an urgent delivery (S1), vaults the same turnstile three paces behind him, and the turnstile arm he strikes spins in the foreground. The camera executes a tracking shot at fast speed alongside the agent with the camera shaking strongly. [Shot 2] The shot cuts to a medium close shot of the agent alone on the stairwell landing, the suspect already out of frame on the steps below. His rubber sole skids on the wet concrete as he grabs the handrail with one hand and touches his earpiece with the other, and the agent (S1) barks into his tactical comms: <d>[English] Suspect is heading down to the lower tracks!</d> His lips snap shut and he runs on down the stairs. The camera pushes in with large amplitude at fast speed toward his focused face. [Shot 3] The shot cuts to a wide low-angle shot from the platform floor looking up the same concrete stairwell, yellow emergency strobes pulsing against the soot-stained ceiling. The suspect leaps the last four steps and lands on the platform, and the agent jumps down behind him and tackles him to the concrete, so that both men end the shot on the platform floor with the agent pinning the suspect. The camera holds a static shot.

overall_soundscape: Rubber boot soles hammer against tiled stairs under the deep reverberating boom of subway tunnels. Metal turnstile gates click and rattle violently, accompanied by sharp gasps of heavy breathing and the distant metallic screech of approaching train wheels.

non_diegetic_music: Relentless cinematic action percussion at a fast tempo, featuring rapid sixteenth-note taiko rhythms, gritty distorted synth bass pulses, and accelerating metal impacts that build in volume up to the final second.
